plans.label: Plan 1
plans.rationale: Well-grounded: threshold pace, HR zones, 200-min base, correct 4 days, and sensibly reframes 44:00 to 45:00. Smooth +7-10% build with recovery week. Flaws: week 8 labelled taper duplicates peak week (full intervals/threshold/75-min long run, no -41% cut), and mardi run+strength (~70 min) exceeds the 60-min weekday cap.
